name: MFE-Mediaforeurope N.V.
summary: MFE-Mediaforeurope N.V. operates in the television industry in Italy and Spain. It is involved in the content production and third-party content acquisition; and content distribution for linear and non-linear, and free-to-air and pay-per-view television across various platforms and radio content. The company also engages in the advertising sale for television and radio operations through its concessionaires and online; and sells advertising space on managed media with cross-media coverage.
